final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT rfistat, AVG(modindex) AS a FROM signals GROUP BY rfistat), s2 AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS b FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.rfistat AS rfistat, s1.a AS a, s1.a - s2.b AS diff FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.b IS NOT NULL WHERE s1.a > s2.b), s4 AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS d FROM s3) SELECT s3.rfistat, s3.a AS C, s3.diff AS "A_minus_B", s3.a - s4.d AS "C_minus_D" FROM s3 JOIN s4 ON s4.d IS NOT NULL
